description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeDao component of the OrangeHRM application, specifically testing data access methods related to Employee entities within the PIM module.

classes.name: EmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: Test class for EmployeeDao functions, verifying various employee data retrieval and manipulation methods within the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeDao instance and populates test data before each test case.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate IDs list based on supervisor ID with various parameters.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate list for a given supervisor.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_Simple2LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Validates subordinate list retrieval in a simple two-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_3LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Validates subordinate list retrieval in a three-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Checks whether a given employee ID is recognized as a supervisor.

methods.name: getEmployeeIds
methods.description: Helper method extracting employee IDs from Employee objects for verification.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdListOneEmployee
methods.description: Tests employee ID list retrieval after deleting multiple employees, leaving one.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployees
methods.description: Tests deletion of employees by ID list, including edge cases of empty list.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of supervisor IDs for given subordinate IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Checks if employee work shift details are correctly retrieved.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeList
methods.description: Validates employee list retrieval with various filters, sorts, and subunit constraints.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Tests fetching employee numbers based on filter parameters with different criteria.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Verifies count of employees retrieved with filters, ensuring correct filtering.

methods.name: testGetEmailList
methods.description: Checks correctness of the list of emails obtained from employee data.

methods.name: testIsWorkEmailIsAvailable
methods.description: Tests if specific email addresses are correctly identified as available or taken.
